transcript: Speaker A: Chat Pe Farratedar, Real Mein Silent. [Fluent on chat, silent in real life.] Speaker B: Yaar, Likhte Time Sochne Ka Time Mil Jaata Hai. Bolne Mein Main Poora Blank Ho Jaati Hun. [Friend, while writing I get time to think. While speaking, I go completely blank.] Speaker A: Kyonki Tum Bolne Ki Practice Nahi Karti. Speak Easy App Pe Aao Aur Mere Saath Baat Karo. [Because you don't practice speaking. Come to the Speak Easy App and talk to me.] Speaker B: Par Mujhe Bolte Time Sharm Aati Hai. [But I feel shy while speaking.] Speaker A: Main AI Hun, Tumhara Mazaak Nahi Udaungi. Roj 15 Minute Mere Saath Akele Practice Karo. Typing Chhodo, Bolna Shuru Karo. Neeche Click Karke Speak Easy App Abhi Download Karo. [I am an AI, I won't make fun of you. Practice alone with me for 15 minutes daily. Stop typing, start speaking. Click below to download the Speak Easy App now.] Speaker C: Abhi Speakeasy App Download Karein Aur Farratedar English Bolna Shuru Karein. [Download the Speakeasy App now and start speaking fluent English.]
